items.t: KEEL or P: Which Technology Services Stock Is Better-Placed Now?
items.sum: Everpure and KEEL are riding the AI wave, but contrasting growth prospects, profitability trends and stock performance give one technology services stock an edge.

items.t: Keel is one step closer to first AI lease as it secures Sharon permit
items.sum: Keel Infrastructure secured the final environmental permit for its 110-megawatt Sharon, Pennsylvania, data center, clearing a significant development hurdle as the company works to sign its first AI infrastructure lease.

items.t: Pennsylvania approves construction-stormwater permit for KEEL’s Sharon data center site
items.sum: The Chapter 102 approval lets KEEL begin earthwork in Sharon under erosion controls. It does not cover power, zoning or air emissions, and KEEL has yet to name a tenant…

CoreWeave Stock Surges After Nvidia Reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
items.sum: CoreWeave shares are soaring Monday with its AI cloud services peers after Nvidia brought back CEO Jensen Huang, lifting AI demand optimism.
